Proposition
[Punctured-torus lamination space] 1. 9.5.2,9.5.3\group thurston.ch09.interpolationSource: thurston:page-0260Source: thurston:page-0261 For the once-punctured torus $T-p$, every projective measured lamination is represented by a slope and $\mathcal{PL}_0(T-p)$ is a circle. The locus $\mathcal T_\gamma $ is determined by the complementary slope data.
